style_en: Japanese TV anime style, crisp clean line art, cel-shaded coloring, calm muted colors, bright even lighting. The same art style in every episode. The background is always pure white.
avoid_en: any text, letters, numbers, logos, modern clothes, Chinese-style clothing, nudity, blood

ebisu.desc_en: Ebisu, the god of fortune, a plump cheerful elderly man with a round smiling face and narrow laughing eyes, a tall black eboshi hat, a kariginu hunting robe in muted gold and green, holding a bamboo fishing rod in his right hand and a large red sea bream under his left arm

murabito.desc_en: an old Japanese village woman of the Edo period in her late 60s, gray hair tied in a simple low bun, a kind wrinkled round face, a faded indigo cotton kimono with a plain brown apron and a white tasuki cord, straw sandals
